caption: The drawing depicts a lidded vessel with two handles, centered on a plain, off-white background. The vessel is predominantly gray with a slight bluish tint, and subtle textural lines suggest a metallic or pewter surface. The vessel has a round, slightly tapering body with a horizontal band encircling the widest section. The lid features a prominent, scalloped or petal-like edge and a handle at the top, shaped like a geometric loop. Two angular handles extend from each side of the vessel’s body, connecting just below the lid down to the widest part of the vessel. The base of the vessel is slightly wider than the bottom portion of the body and is edged with a greenish hue. The artist's signature, “Richard Taylor,” appears in small, neat cursive script in the lower right portion of the image.
title: Enamel Pitcher
